The Build New Games demo: Node + socket.io + two coloured rectangles
on a 720×480 canvas, with client prediction and a server tick. That
Node process, socket.io, express, and dat.gui stay behind.

This port keeps the arena size and the idea (two — now many — players
in one room, host browser is the authority) and draws actual tanks
with turrets, bullets, walls, and phone sticks. Each player writes
only their own row. Invite is the room.
